We got list of templates. Need the one that corresponds to electrophilic bromination of aromatic ring. Look at templates: many involve I (iodine) not Br. The first template: retro_smarts_template '[I;H0;D1;+0:4]-[c;H0;D3;+0:1](:[c:2]):[c:3]>>N-[c;H0;D3;+0:1](:[c:2]):[c:3].[c:...]' That's iodine to amine? Not bromination.

We need a template that forms C-Br bond. None shown yet. Maybe need to search with functional_groups_formed=["halide"] but maybe halide includes Br. The returned templates involve I. Could be because halide includes any halogen. Need template that forms Br. Could search again with maybe "bromide". Let's try functional_groups_formed=["bromide"].
